Carrington College is a leading provider of postsecondary education in the health care sector with programs that offer hands-on experience and prepare graduates for employment in such fields as dental assisting, and pharmacy technology. Carrington College is accredited by the Accrediting Commission for Community and Junior Colleges of the Western Association of Schools and Colleges (ACCJC-WASC).

Posting on this page does not necessary represent the views or opinions of Carrington College, or its affiliates. Nothing on this page constitutes a binding representation, agreement or an endorsement on the part of Carrington College, or its affiliates.
